title.value: Emerging Bronchoscopic Therapies for Lung Disease: Targeted Lung Denervation, Rheoplasty, and Spray Cryotherapy [source_page: 1; source_excerpt: 'Emerging Bronchoscopic Therapies for Lung Disease: Targeted Lung Denervation, Rheoplasty, and Spray Cryotherapy']

diagnostic_approaches.name: Chronic bronchitis diagnostic definition
diagnostic_approaches.purpose: Define the chronic bronchitis phenotype within COPD
criteria_or_scoring: cough and sputum production for at least 3 months in at least 2 years
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: Chronic bronchitis is deﬁned as cough and sputum pro- duction for at least 3 months in at least 2 years.

diagnostic_approaches.name: Exacerbation count criterion for Targeted Lung Denervation
diagnostic_approaches.purpose: Identify COPD patients with frequent exacerbations for TLD consideration
criteria_or_scoring: at least two moderate exacerbations in the last 12 months
diagnostic_approaches.interpretation: are possible candidates for this treatment.
diagnostic_approaches.when_to_use: Targeted lung denervation addresses patients with COPD and frequent exacerbations.
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: Patients with at least two moderate exacerbations in the last 12 months, requiring antibiotic or corticosteroid treatment, are possible candidates for this treatment.

diagnostic_approaches.name: Pre-procedural CT assessment for TLD (anatomy and emphysema index threshold)
diagnostic_approaches.purpose: Assess bronchial anatomy suitability and exclude severe emphysema before TLD
criteria_or_scoring: bronchial anatomy allows treatment with the available catheter sizes
diagnostic_approaches.how_to_perform: A prior CT scan is performed to check anatomy and exclude severe emphysema based on emphysema index.
diagnostic_approaches.interpretation: Exclude patients if emphysema index >50% at -950 HU.
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: A prior CT (computed tomography) scan is performed… and to exclude patients with severe emphysema (>50% emphysema index at Hounseﬁeld Units—950).

diagnostic_approaches.name: CAT questionnaire thresholds for Rheoplasty selection
diagnostic_approaches.purpose: Select chronic bronchitis patients with high symptom burden for bronchial rheoplasty
criteria_or_scoring: first two questions on sputum and cough ≥7 and the complete score ≥10
diagnostic_approaches.interpretation: leading to entry into this treatment option.
limitations: Objective measure of sputum volume and disease burden is difficult to find.
diagnostic_approaches.when_to_use: When considering bronchial rheoplasty for chronic bronchitis
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: ﬁrst two questions on sputum and cough ≥7 and the complete score ≥10 leading to entry into this treatment option.

diagnostic_approaches.name: Emphysema index threshold for Rheoplasty exclusion
diagnostic_approaches.purpose: Exclude patients with significant emphysema from bronchial rheoplasty
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: exclusion criteria are the presence of pulmonary emphysema (emphysema index >25% at -950 Hounseﬁeld Units)

diagnostic_approaches.name: Eligibility criterion for Spray Cryotherapy (CB + COPD duration)
criteria_or_scoring: diagnosis of chronic bronchitis and COPD for at least 2 years
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: Patients with a diagnosis of chronic bronchitis and COPD for at least 2 years are eligible for this treatment.

diagnostic_approaches.name: SGRQ (St. George’s Respiratory Questionnaire)
diagnostic_approaches.interpretation: Symptom scores were reduced at follow-up time points.
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: Symptom scores of SGRQ (St. George’s Respiratory Questionnaire) and CAT were reduced at 6 and 12 months

diagnostic_approaches.name: Leicester Cough Questionnaire (LCQ)
diagnostic_approaches.interpretation: Patients experienced benefits in scores at 3 months.
diagnostic_approaches.source_excerpt: Patients experienced beneﬁts in symptom scores (SGRQ, CAT, Leicester Cough Questionnaire) at 3 months

clinical_guidelines.title: Targeted Lung Denervation: patient selection and procedural recommendations
specific_recommendations: {'text': 'Candidates: at least two moderate exacerbations in the last 12 months requiring antibiotic or corticosteroid treatment.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'Patients with at least two moderate exacerbations in the last 12 months, requiring antibiotic or corticosteroid treatment, are possible candidates for this treatment.'}

{'text': 'Do not treat if bacterial-driven exacerbations due to persistent colonization with pathogenic bacteria or significant gastrointestinal comorbidities.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'Patients with bacterial-driven exacerbations that are due to persistent colonization with pathogenic bacteria or significant gastrointestinal comorbidities should not undergo TLD.'}
{'text': 'Exclude patients with a diagnosis of asthma.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'Currently, patients with a diagnosis of asthma are excluded from treatment.'}

{'text': 'Pre-procedure CT to confirm anatomy and exclude severe emphysema (>50% emphysema index at Hounsefield Units—950).', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'to exclude patients with severe emphysema (>50% emphysema index at Hounsefield Units—950).'}
{'text': 'Select energy level based on anatomy (26–32 watts).', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'the energy level is chosen dependent on the individual anatomy (26–32 watts).'}
{'text': 'Ablation parameters: 120 s activation and 30 s postcooling.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'radio- frequency ablation requires 120 s of activation and 30 s of postcooling.'}

{'text': 'Introduce an esophageal balloon and maintain distance to avoid gastric vagal fiber ablation and GI side effects.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'a balloon catheter, filled with contrast, has been introduced into the esophagus… maintain an appropriate distance… to avoid ablation of gastric vagal fibers and to prevent gastrointestinal side effects.'}

{'text': 'Place catheter in both main bronchi circumferentially to ablate vagal fibers at four different positions.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'placed in both main bronchi circumferentially to ablate the vagal fibers at four different positions.'}
{'text': 'Give prophylactic antibiotic and cortisone treatment.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'Prophylactic antibiotic and cortisone treatment is given.'}
{'text': 'Expected duration: complete procedure lasts about 74 min.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'The complete procedure lasts about 74 min [4].'}

{'text': 'Possible side effects: COPD exacerbation, pulmonary infection, airway mucosa damage, gastrointestinal side effects.', 'source_page': 2, 'source_excerpt': 'Possible side effects include COPD exacerbation, pulmonary infection, damage to the airway mucosa, and gastrointestinal side effects.'}

clinical_guidelines.title: Bronchial Rheoplasty: patient selection and procedural recommendations
specific_recommendations: {'text': 'Use CAT questionnaire; first two questions on sputum and cough ≥7 and complete score ≥10 for entry.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'with the first two questions on sputum and cough ≥7 and the complete score ≥10 leading to entry into this treatment option.'}

{'text': 'Exclude patients with cardiac arrhythmias or implantable electronic devices.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'Patients with cardiac arrhythmias or implantable electronic devices cannot be treated'}
{'text': 'Exclude pulmonary emphysema (emphysema index >25% at -950 Hounsefield Units).', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'pulmonary emphysema (emphysema index >25% at -950 Hounsefield Units)'}
{'text': 'Exclude diagnosis of asthma bronchiale.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'a diagnosis of asthma bronchiale'}

{'text': 'Exclude known airway colonization with resistant organisms such as pseudomonas.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'a known airway colonization with resistant organisms such as pseudomonas.'}

{'text': 'Two sessions under general anesthesia: right side then 4–6 weeks later left side.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'performed under general anesthesia in two sessions, one on the right side and 4–6 weeks apart on the left side.'}
{'text': 'Reduce FiO2 to 30% during activations.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'With FiO2 reduced to 30%'}
{'text': 'Apply electric current over 5 s per activation.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'then electric current is applied over 5 s'}
{'text': 'Average duration 40 min with 40–60 activations per lung side.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'The average duration of the procedure is 40 min with 40–60 activations per lung side.'}
{'text': 'Apply corticosteroids to prevent COPD exacerbation.', 'source_page': 4, 'source_excerpt': 'Corticosteroids are applied to prevent COPD exacerbation'}

clinical_guidelines.title: Spray Cryotherapy: patient selection and procedural recommendations
specific_recommendations: {'text': 'Eligible: diagnosis of chronic bronchitis and COPD for at least 2 years.', 'source_page': 5, 'source_excerpt': 'Patients with a diagnosis of chronic bronchitis and COPD for at least 2 years are eligible for this treatment.'}
{'text': 'Exclude asthma bronchiale or bronchiectasis.', 'source_page': 5, 'source_excerpt': 'Current exclusion criteria are a diagnosis of asthma bronchiale or bronchiectasis.'}

{'text': 'Deliver liquid nitrogen to create a 10 mm circular cryoablation zone with depth 0.1–0.5 mm.', 'source_page': 5, 'source_excerpt': 'with the aim of creating a 10 mm circular cryoablation zone with a depth of 0.1–0.5 mm.'}

{'text': 'Stop ventilation during application and usually deflate endotracheal cuff.', 'source_page': 5, 'source_excerpt': 'Ventilation must be stopped during application and the cuff of the endotracheal tube is usually deflated'}

{'text': 'Three procedures required: right lower lobe/main stem; left lower lobe/main stem; both upper lobes/distal trachea.', 'source_page': 6, 'source_excerpt': 'Three procedures are required, with the right lower lobe and main stem bronchus… the left lower lobe and main stem… both upper lobes and the distal end of the trachea'}
{'text': 'Do not treat right middle lobe due to higher barotrauma risk.', 'source_page': 6, 'source_excerpt': 'The right middle lobe is not treated because of the expected higher risk of barotrauma'}
{'text': 'Mean number of spray deliveries per procedure: 20.', 'source_page': 6, 'source_excerpt': 'The mean number of spray deliveries per procedure was reported to be 20'}
{'text': 'Mean procedure time: 34 min.', 'source_page': 6, 'source_excerpt': 'and the mean procedure time was 34 min [10].'}
